issue: OpenAPI 4.215.0 uses additionalProperties=false inside the first allOf branch of the create-instance request. It rejects label, region and type declared by later branches, even though the provider create-instance docs explicitly accept them.

OpenAPI 4.215.0 declares the X-Filter header as a schema object with default header serialization instead of JSON content. The provider explicitly documents JSON-encoded filter objects in this header, including +order_by and +order. The triggers send that documented JSON representation.
